static_traits.name: Chen Lin
static_traits.social_status: Difficulty trusting others' reactions,leading to Relationship tension with colleagues and friends;has a close friend,but often hesitates to share the deepest unease
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness;has not yet received psychotherapy in the past
static_traits.language_features: Positive attitude, clear expression, able to self-reflect, highly cooperative

basic_info.main_problem: I constantly worry that others find me annoying,which leads to Self-doubt and insecurity,and affects socializing and film creation;especially more evident after interacting with others or sharing works,and I doubt the authenticity of others' reactions,feeling Anxiety in social settings.
basic_info.core_demands: I hope to stop constantly worrying about annoying others in social settings,and to stop repeatedly doubting every decision in creation.
growth_experiences: Reports having experienced Being rejected and being misunderstood in the past,believing it related to the current problem;such experiences make them highly sensitive to others' reactions and prone to Self-doubt.
During challenging periods of the career,Self-doubt and insecurity repeatedly appeared;the usual coping style is to throw oneself into Work to displace attention.
In recent months,several projects have not received the anticipated response,worsening their Self-doubt and Anxiety.

core_beliefs: My worth depends on how others react to me

special_situations.event: After interacting with others or sharing his own film works
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others have not given clear and enthusiastic positive feedback,it means I am dislikable or my works are not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly speculating about and checking others' reactions, doubting the authenticity of the feedback, and trying even harder to amuse and please the other person
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They actually find me annoying,just too embarrassed to say so

special_situations.event: When encountering an individual who gives a negative reaction to one's work or interaction
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If just one person reacts negatively,it means everyone thinks so;to not be disliked,I must satisfy everyone
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: In socializing, performs and jokes harder, or avoids further communication to dodge negative evaluations
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone must think I am annoying

special_situations.event: Several projects have not received the anticipated market or audience response
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the project response is poor,it must be my problem,meaning I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Throwing oneself into Work,shooting late at night,compensating the felt inadequacy with effort and perfection
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It is all my fault,I am not suited for filmmaking

special_situations.event: When others smile, praise, or give positive responses in interactions
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Positive feedback is not reliable,possibly just politeness or perfunctoriness,and does not prove I am not annoying
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignoring or downplaying positive feedback, continuing to look for potential negative clues
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Their laughter is just politeness,they do not really think well of me

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be liked and accepted, and hoping one's works are genuinely affirmed
core_conflict.fear: Fear of Being rejected,being seen as annoying,being misunderstood,worrying others' reactions are not sincere
defense_goal: Avoids being disliked by pleasing and performing harder
Avoiding the feeling of Being rejected by throwing oneself into Work
Preempts through self-blame to reduce the blow of external criticism

object_relations.self_representation: A person who tries hard to please yet is easily misunderstood and may annoy others
object_relations.object_representation: Picky others who are easily annoyed and whose reactions are not sincere

object_relations.self_representation: The 'one at fault' who blames oneself entirely for failure
object_relations.object_representation: Others/audiences with judgmental and negating tendencies

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor/others present neutral or not immediately affirmative feedback
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The other may find me annoying like people in the past and want to negate me(transference: viewing others as potential rejecters)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Tentative tone,repeatedly seeking confirmation whether the other is dissatisfied or annoyed,use questions like 'do you also find me annoying'.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to describe in depth the experiences of Being rejected/being misunderstood and current emotions
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: If I expose my true feelings, I will be judged or rejected
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use generalized,non-emotional descriptions,keep an even tone,reduce emotional vocabulary and intensity,turn to facts and analysis.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about poor project response or external criticism
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Negative outcomes are mainly my fault,others are all judging me
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Quickly taking full responsibility,use expressions like 'It is all my fault''I am not good enough',in a self-blaming tone,avoiding discussion of external factors.

manifestations: Lives alone and lacks close family support
Distrust of the authenticity of others' reactions leads to Relationship tension
Even with close friends,hesitating to share the deepest unease

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Believing others find oneself annoying,doubting the authenticity of others' positive reactions
Externalizes the self-loathing experience as others' negative views

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Repeatedly ruminating after interacting with people, over-interpreting a single negative cue
Cautious in communication, tentatively seeking the other party's approval

positive_force: Positive attitude; willing to cooperate with recording and practicing cognitive restructuring
Some awareness of one's own negative thinking patterns(able to identify 'overgeneralization''personalization''negating the positive')
Stable interest in and commitment to filmmaking, with intrinsic motivation
Has a friend who can be contacted, with potential support resources
negative_force: Overly concerned about others' evaluations; depends on external validation
Mind reading and jumping to conclusions, tending to generalize a single negative reaction
Strong personalization and self-blame tendencies; ignores positive feedback
Rumination and Sleep disturbance,reducing resilience and Work/social efficiency
Maintaining avoidance and caution toward deep self-exposure in intimate communication

target_behavior.behavior: Repeatedly ruminating after social interactions and anxiously suspecting others find oneself annoying
antecedent: After sharing or receiving feedback on the film work
target_behavior.core_reason: Past experiences of Being rejected and being misunderstood compounded by cognitive distortions(mind reading,overgeneralization,personalization)
target_behavior.function: Escaping the emotional pain of Being rejected,seeking a sense of certainty and control
target_behavior.consequence: Social Anxiety worsened,Relationship tension with colleagues and friends,impaired collaboration and creative efficiency

target_behavior.behavior: Disrupted sleep patterns(difficulty falling asleep due to late-night shooting and rumination)
antecedent: The evening after interacting with others or receiving evaluations
target_behavior.core_reason: Avoiding Anxiety and insecurity by throwing oneself into Work and ruminating
target_behavior.function: Temporarily displacing attention,reducing the subjective experience of immediate Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Daytime fatigue, heightened emotional sensitivity, work and social performance affected
